caseNameFull: O'Connor v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Newell S. Boardman for petitioners. Solicitor General Griswold, Assistant Attorney General Walters, Joseph M. Howard, and John P. Burke for respondent.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Motion to substitute John K. O’Connor, Executor of Estate of Raymond A. O’Connor, deceased, in place of Raymond A. O’Connor, as a party petitioner, granted. Certiorari denied.
